notes: ADJUDICATED 2026-11-08. Spans are sliced verbatim from data/processed/articles.jsonl by scripts/draft_gold_graphs.py and each edge passes the B6 rule layer. Two annotators then labelled every drafted edge independently, blind to the draft and to each other: raw agreement 0.800 on whether the span asserts the relation, Cohen's kappa 0.231 under a dominant label, with direction and strength agreeing on every edge both kept (reports/adjudication_kappa.md). Reconciliation dropped four drafted edges under one rule, D-26: a span that states a relation or a pricing mechanism without stating which way the destination moves cannot back a gold edge that carries a direction. The reviewers' own attestation lives in data/eval/gold/dev/review_receipt.json and is signed separately.
